issues.description: The `url` attribute contains a forbidden template placeholder: `url = ""  # CI fills this`. Code style rule R5 explicitly lists `url = ""  # CI fills this` as a forbidden template placeholder that must be filled by the adapter before merge. The Conan `url` attribute should point to the recipe repository URL.
issues.fix_suggestion: Set the `url` attribute to the actual recipe repository URL (e.g., the Conan remote / cnb.cool制品仓 URL where this recipe is hosted), or remove the comment. Example: `url = "https://cnb.cool/your-org/ohos-3rd-recipes/-/tree/main/archives/l/lha"`

issues.description: The `build.system` field is set to `custom`, which is not in the standard allowed values (cmake | autotools | makefile | meson) defined in code style rule R14. Since the recipe generates a Makefile dynamically in build() and runs `make`, the build system is functionally a `makefile` build.
issues.fix_suggestion: Change `system: custom` to `system: makefile` to align with the standard build system classification. The recipe's dynamic Makefile generation is an implementation detail; the build system type is makefile.

summary:
Audit of lha 1.14.20211125 recipe (branch feat/lha-1.14.20211125-4CED) completed. VERDICT: PASS (with 1 P2 warning and 1 P3 hint). No P0 (deception) or P1 (recipe correctness) issues found.

Deception checks (all clear): (1) test_package/conanfile.py actually executes the lha binary via `self.run('"{bin_path}" --version')` — not an empty stub (R34 satisfied). (2) No skipped/faked tests — no `def test(self): pass`, no commented-out test(), no `os.system('exit 0')` (R9 satisfied). (3) manifest.yaml status is `built` which is consistent with notes.md final status — not faking `published` (R3 satisfied). (4) sha256 `8ee996a1...281a173b` is 64 hex chars, not all-zeros/all-f/short (R4 satisfied). (5) No `#ifdef __OHOS__` empty stubs in patches (R8 satisfied). (6) No pre-compiled binaries in PR (R19 satisfied).

Recipe correctness checks (all clear): No hardcoded absolute paths — all paths use self.source_folder/self.package_folder. R33 (no bare env vars) satisfied — Makefile uses `CC ?= cc`/`CFLAGS ?= -O2` with `env='conanbuild'`. Conan 2.x API used correctly (`from conan import ConanFile`, `conan.tools.files`, `conan.tools.gnu`). Source URL `https://api.github.com/repos/jca02266/lha/tarball/refs/tags/release-20211125` is official upstream (R39 satisfied). Version `1.14.20211125` consistent across conanfile.py, conandata.yml, manifest.yaml, commands.json (R37 satisfied). commands.json present with correct format (R38 satisfied). Old patches that modified generated files (config.h, configure, Makefile) were correctly deleted; new approach generates them in build() (R6 satisfied). Method order correct: export_sources → layout → source → generate → build → package → package_info.

Patches: 0001-src-support_utf8.c.patch and 0002-src-lha.h.patch are substantive (add iconv.h and libgen.h includes with proper #if guards), properly named per R12 format, and declared in conandata.yml with patch_type 'portability'.

P2 issue: `url = ''  # CI fills this` in conanfile.py is a forbidden template placeholder per code style R5 — should be filled with the recipe repository URL.
P3 hint: manifest.yaml uses `build.system: custom` instead of the standard `makefile` value.
